newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Azerbaijan seeks foreign help after heavy flooding.
newsitem.headline: Azerbaijan seeks foreign help after heavy flooding.

text.p: Azerbaijan on Wednesday appealed for international help after summer floods that killed 11 people and caused more than $4 million in property damage.

A cabinet statement called on the United Nations and foreign countries to help alleviate the effects of heavy rains which have inundated the central part of the former Soviet republic over the past two weeks.
Some 7,000 homes and 40 road bridges have been damaged and 5,300 hectares of wheat crops and 2,500 hectares of cotton have been destoyed, the statement said.
The country's largest hydroelectric plant at Mingachaur, 300 km (180 miles) west of the capital Baku, has shut down after being damaged in the floods, causing some power cuts.
